description: The chart in Figure 3 illustrates the execution accuracy of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev, comparing the performance of NatSQL and TA-SQL across various levels of difficulty. The horizontal axis represents the categories of query difficulty, labeled as "Simple", "Moderate", "Challenging", and "Total", while the vertical axis is labeled "Execution Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60. The bars are grouped by query difficulty, with each group containing two bars representing NatSQL and TA-SQL, colored in light blue and dark blue, respectively. The values for NatSQL are approximately 60.21, 39.64, 32.32, and 51.35 for the respective categories, while TA-SQL has values of around 63.14, 48.60, 36.11, and 56.19. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar. Overall, the chart provides a clear comparison of the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across different levels of query difficulty.
